title: ISL Opentrons Pipeline: gDNA Bead Cleanup
author: Jhakelin Reyes Vasquez
materials: Materials: Autoclave and UV the items you will use to ensure sterility. Some items can be autoclaved and reused as indicated below. Reagents: Prepare all reagents in advance: Nuclease-free Water Contributed by users Solutions for Purifying DNA by solid-phase reversible immobilization (SPRI) lab-made Contributed by users 3. 70% Alcohol Contributed by users , freshly prepared 4. This allows you to cleanup a small volume, but larger volumes are easily cleaned with the same protocol. Simply add water 1:1, and then proceed. A B C D 1 Ingredient Amount per sample Amount per 96 samples Notes 2 Water 25 2400 3 SPRI beads 36 7200 1.5x water+sample 4 70% ethanol 250 24000 In our experience, DNA recovery following SPRI bead cleanups is higher when total volumes used for the incubation steps are higher. This, however, does cost more in terms of beads. If you can afford it in your protocol though, always augment your DNA needing cleanup to 100-200uL, and add beads in a 1.5 ratio to those volumes. Air dry OT2 robot and modules.
Nest skirted PCR Plate with TNA Slot
Calibrate the deck. Follow the onscreen instructions.

steps.title: Arrange OT‑2 deck
steps.instruction: Place labware as follows: Slot 1 – Magnetic Module with empty Nest skirted PCR plate (to receive cleaned DNA); Slot 2 – Nest skirted PCR plate containing TNA elution (gTNA_plate_A); Slot 3 – NEST 12‑Well Reservoir (15 mL) loaded with reagents in order: Well 1 SPRI beads, Well 5 70 % ethanol (wash 1), Well 6 70 % ethanol (wash 2), Well 9 water; Slot 4 – Opentrons 200 µL filter tips; Slot 5 – Opentrons 200 µL filter tips; Slot 6 – Axygen PCR‑tube storage rack with 96‑well non‑skirted plate (clean_up_plate); Slot 7 – Opentrons 200 µL filter tips; Slot 8 – Opentrons 200 µL filter tips; Slot 9 – Opentrons 200 µL filter tips; Slot 10 – NEST 1‑Well Reservoir (195 mL) for waste; Slot 11 – Opentrons 200 µL filter tips.

steps.title: Load labware definitions
steps.instruction: In the Opentrons app, load the labware file denville_96_axygenbase_200ul.json to enable use of a nonskirted 200 µL plate inside a skirted plate.

steps.title: Load protocol script
steps.instruction: Load cleanup_gDNA_v4.4.py into the Opentrons app (or the shortened test version cleanup_gDNA_v4.4.w.py).

steps.title: Clean OT‑2 robot
steps.instruction: Wipe the OT‑2 deck and walls with 10 % bleach (1 rinse), then distilled water (1 rinse), then 70 % alcohol (2 rinses) avoiding electronic parts; clean the OT‑2 modules with 70 % alcohol (2 rinses); dry the robot and modules thoroughly.

steps.title: Prepare water reagent
steps.instruction: Add ultrapure distilled, nuclease‑free water to the NEST 12‑Well Reservoir (Well 9, Slot 3) in a 1:1 volume ratio to the samples (25 µL per well) and warm to 55 °C.

steps.title: Prepare SPRI bead reagent
steps.instruction: Add SPRI beads to the NEST 12‑Well Reservoir (Well 1, Slot 3) at a 1:1.5 (sample:bead) ratio, accounting for the 25 µL sample + 25 µL water (total 50 µL), thus 75 µL beads per well.

steps.title: Prepare ethanol washes
steps.instruction: Place freshly prepared 70 % ethanol in the NEST 12‑Well Reservoir: 100 µL per well in Well 5 (first wash) and 100 µL per well in Well 6 (second wash).

steps.title: Transfer water to magnetic plate
steps.instruction: Using the first column of tips from Slot 11, dispense 25 µL water from Well 9 (Slot 3) into each column of the empty Nest skirted PCR plate on the magnetic module (Slot 1).

steps.title: Transfer gTNA sample
steps.instruction: Using tips from Slot 11, mix each 25 µL gTNA sample in the gTNA_plate_A (Slot 2) and transfer it to the corresponding well of the magnetic plate (Slot 1).

steps.title: Add SPRI beads
steps.instruction: Using the first column of tips from Slot 5, dispense 75 µL SPRI beads from Well 1 (Slot 3) into each well of the magnetic plate (Slot 1).

steps.title: Mix samples with beads
steps.instruction: With tips from Slot 4, perform two mixing cycles per column (first column, then second, … up to 12th) for a total of ~15 min; ensure homogeneous color. After mixing, incubate on the magnetic module for 6 min (pelleting_time).

steps.title: Engage magnet to settle beads
steps.instruction: Engage the Opentrons magnetic module for 6 min to allow beads to pellet.

steps.title: Remove supernatant gently
steps.instruction: Using tips from Slot 4, aspirate the supernatant in two gentle steps and dispense into the waste reservoir (Slot 10).

steps.title: First ethanol wash
steps.instruction: Using the second column of tips from Slot 5, dispense 100 µL 70 % ethanol from Well 5 (Slot 3) into each well of the magnetic plate (Slot 1).

steps.title: Remove first ethanol wash
steps.instruction: After a 30 s incubation, aspirate the ethanol supernatant in two gentle steps with tips from Slot 4 and discard into waste (Slot 10).

steps.title: Second ethanol wash
steps.instruction: Using the second column of tips from Slot 5, dispense 100 µL 70 % ethanol from Well 6 (Slot 3) into each well of the magnetic plate (Slot 1).

steps.title: Remove second ethanol wash
steps.instruction: After a 30 s incubation, aspirate the ethanol supernatant in two gentle steps with tips from Slot 4 and discard into waste (Slot 10).

steps.title: Remove residual ethanol
steps.instruction: Aspirate an additional ~30 µL of remaining ethanol with tips from Slot 4, being careful not to disturb beads, and discard into waste (Slot 10).

steps.title: Dry beads
steps.instruction: Pause the protocol for 5 min at room temperature to let ethanol evaporate; do not over‑dry (beads change from dark brown to light brown).

steps.title: Add elution water
steps.instruction: Disengage the magnetic module, then using tips from Slot 7 dispense 19 µL ultrapure water from Well 9 (Slot 3) into each column of the clean_up_plate (Slot 6) and mix immediately.

steps.title: Mix beads after elution addition
steps.instruction: With tips from Slot 7, mix each column of the clean_up_plate for ~10 min to resuspend beads thoroughly.

steps.title: Bind beads to magnet
steps.instruction: Re‑engage the magnetic module for 6 min to pellet the beads after elution mixing.

steps.title: Transfer eluted DNA
steps.instruction: Using tips from Slot 8, transfer 19 µL of the eluate from the magnetic plate (Slot 1) to the corresponding well of the clean_up_plate (Slot 6).

steps.title: Seal and store plate
steps.instruction: Cover the clean_up_plate with a plate seal and store at 4 °C for short‑term use or –20 °C for long‑term storage.
